topic: Claude Code for non-coders: turn a spreadsheet export into a summary and a chart
post:
Got a spreadsheet export you never have time to make sense of? 📊
Let Claude Code turn it into a summary and a chart, in plain English.

Here's the secret: to make a chart, Claude Code writes a tiny program and runs it for you. You never have to read the code. You just approve it. ✅

Try it 👇
1️⃣ Make a new folder and put a COPY of your file in it (a CSV or Excel export)
2️⃣ Open Claude Code and point it at that folder
3️⃣ Paste the prompt below
4️⃣ Read each permission pop-up before you approve
5️⃣ Open the chart image it saves

Copy this prompt:
"Look at the spreadsheet in this folder. Tell me in plain English what's in it, the 3 biggest trends, and anything that looks odd. Then make one bar chart of the most important number and save it as chart.png. Don't change the original file."

Double-check the numbers ✅
Spot-check a few totals against your spreadsheet before you share anything.

📌 Claude Code is included with Claude's Pro and Max plans.

Why it matters:
You don't need to learn formulas or charts to get answers from your data. You need a clear question. 💡

What data would you love a quick chart of? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
